views.markdown:
YTHideProgress hides YouTube's progress bar while you are not using it, so it stops pulling your eye to how much is left.

- **Player**: the line under the video goes away while the controls are hidden, in portrait and (optionally) landscape. Tap the video and it comes back with the controls.
- **Miniplayer**: no line along the bottom of the floating player.
- **Thumbnails**: removes the red watched bar, and optionally the video length.
- **Picture in picture and Now Playing**: optional; leaves the progress bar and times out of picture in picture and the Lock Screen, Control Center and Dynamic Island players.
- **Channels**: apply it to every channel, only the channels you list, or all except them. Add a channel from a video's menu; collaboration videos let you pick each channel.
- **Player button**: with YTVideoOverlay, hide or show the progress for the video you're watching.

Settings are in YouTube's settings, under YTHideProgress. Also works injected into a sideloaded YouTube app.

views.title: Compatibility
views.text: iOS 14 and later (rootless, roothide and rootful); tested with YouTube 20.42.3
